panel.why: PM2.5 監測從少數實驗測站開始，1998 年只有 5 站有足夠涵蓋率、2025 年有 77 站。不固定樣本的話，趨勢有一部分是測站網在長大，不是空氣在變化。這裡用的固定樣本規則與第 1 章相同。

formula: PAF = (RR − 1) ÷ RR，RR = exp(β × max(0, C − 反事實濃度))

functions.name: who_2021_allcause
functions.source: Chen J, Hoek G (2020), Environment International 143:105974 — systematic review and meta-analysis of long-term PM2.5 exposure and mortality. This is the pooled estimate the WHO 2021 global air quality guidelines cite for the annual PM2.5 recommendation.
functions.caveat: Log-linear extrapolation. The cohorts behind this estimate are mostly North American and European at concentrations below about 30 μg/m³, so applying it to Taiwan's 1990s levels extrapolates well beyond the observed range. Every result carries the fraction of station-years that sit outside it.

series.name: zero
series.label: 0 μg/m³
series.why: No safe threshold assumed. Simple, and almost certainly wrong at the bottom of the range where the epidemiology has no observations.

series.name: gbd_low
series.label: 2.4 μg/m³
series.why: Lower bound of the GBD 2019 theoretical-minimum-risk exposure level, drawn as a uniform distribution over 2.4–5.9 μg/m³.

series.name: who_guideline
series.label: 5 μg/m³（WHO 2021）
series.why: The WHO 2021 annual guideline. Not a TMREL — it is a policy target — but it is what a reader assumes when a report says "above the guideline".

series.name: gbd_high
series.label: 5.9 μg/m³
series.why: Upper bound of the same TMREL distribution. The gap between this and gbd_low is not a rounding detail: over Taiwan's recent concentrations it moves the attributable fraction by roughly a third.

extrapolation.why: 係數來自的世代研究多半觀測在 30 μg/m³ 以下。高於這個值是外推，不是內插。

not_reported.deaths: 沒有死亡人數。人數 = 比例 × 人口 × 基礎死亡率，而本專案只有測站觀測，沒有人口資料。人口那一項會是誤差最大的來源，卻看起來像句子裡最紮實的部分。
not_reported.exposure: 測站平均不是人口加權暴露。全國數字是「各測站的中位數」，那是關於監測網的陳述，不是關於任何人呼吸到什麼的陳述。
